title: UPDATE of card 008: CNN (Natasha Bertrand, five sources) says NSA Net, the NSA's classified internal network, is down; 'no evidence of a cyberattack'; staggered arrivals ordered. A circulating list of six US IT outages in six days (Microsoft, FAA, AWS, banks, United, NSA): stated causes differ and no link is established
body:
# NSA Net down per CNN (five sources), no evidence of a cyberattack; six outages in six days, no established link

**Upgrade of card 008's NSA line (which carried @disclosetv as unverified).** Will's bookmark @TheIntelFrog (16:09Z) quotes CNN's Natasha Bertrand (15:33Z): "The highly classified network that the National Security Agency uses for its internal communications is down, according to five people familiar with the matter. The network, called NSA Net, allows employees to communicate classified information internally. At this point there is no evidence of a cyberattack, sources said. As the agency works to understand the scope of the problem, it has enacted staggered arrivals for personnel." CNN asked the NSA for comment. Story: cnn.com/2026/11/17/politics/highly-classified-national-security-communications-network-goes-down (not opened by WALTER; text from the quoted post).

**The list now circulating (@TheIntelFrog, 'Unexplained IT outages/issues in the last 6 days'), checked against the BOARD:**

| Date | Outage | What the BOARD holds |
|---|---|---|
| Nov 11-12 | Microsoft 365 / Outlook / Teams | 20261114-002: global, about 24 h; Microsoft cause 'a network capacity upgrade' |
| Nov 13 | FAA air-route traffic control centers, national ground stop | 20261114-001: DHS 'no indication of cyber' |
| Nov 15 | AWS | NOT ON THE BOARD: WALTER has no record of an 11/15 AWS outage; unverified |
| Nov 16 | Chase, US Bank, Wells Fargo, USAA 'etc.' | 20261116-006/-008/-010: Chase-confirmed online-banking outage, Chase says 'not cyber-related'; others user reports; US Bank says not directly impacted |
| Nov 16 | United Airlines | 20261117-008: Fox report of a widespread system outage, cause unread |
| Nov 17 | NSA Net | this card: CNN, no evidence of cyberattack |

**Framing guard:** 'unexplained' is the poster's word. Three of the six have a stated non-cyber cause or denial (Microsoft, FAA via DHS, Chase); none is established as linked to another. Card 008's same-week items (Optimizely supply-chain compromise, DHS secretary 'AI may be behind recent US outages' relay, unverified) are the reason the cluster gets read as one story. Whether it is one is CYPHER's call (escalation watch). WQ-622 A: logged as a combination theme even though no single item moves a score.

route_summary: PRIORITY: CNN says NSA Net down, no evidence of cyberattack; six-outages-in-six-days list checked against BOARD, causes differ, AWS 11/15 unverified. CYPHER action.
